member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.AutoCompleteEvents`2.Filtering
member.summary: Gets or sets the event callback invoked when a character is typed in the component.
member.value: An that is triggered when the user types a character in the AutoComplete input.
member.remarks: This event allows customization of the filtering process by setting FilteringEventArgs.PreventDefaultAction to true and passing a modified data source and query to the FilterAsync(IEnumerable<TItem>, Query, FieldSettingsModel) method.

example.code:
<SfAutoComplete @ref="AutoCompleteObj" TItem="string" TValue="string" AllowFiltering="true" DataSource="@MyList">
                <AutoCompleteEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" Filtering="@OnFilteringHandler"/>
            </SfAutoComplete>
            @code {
                SfAutoComplete<string, string> AutoCompleteObj { get; set; }
                protected List<string> MyList = new List<string>() { "Small", "Medium", "Large" };
                public async Task OnFilteringHandler(FilteringEventArgs args) {
                    args.PreventDefaultAction = true;
                    var query = new Query().Where(new WhereFilter() { Field = "Text", Operator = "contains", value = args.Text, IgnoreCase = true });
                    await AutoCompleteObj.FilterAsync(MyList, query);
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.ComboBoxEvents`2.CustomValueSpecifier
member.summary: Gets or sets the event callback invoked when a custom value not present in the data source is entered.
member.value: An that receives a object when triggered.
member.remarks: This event is triggered when a user enters a value not present in the data source and is enabled. Developers can use this event to define the custom item to be added to the ComboBox.

example.code:
<SfComboBox TValue="int" TItem="Countries" DataSource="@CountryList">
                <ComboBoxEvents TValue="int" TItem="Countries" CustomValueSpecifier="@CustomValue" />
                <ComboBoxFieldSettings Text="Name" Value="Code" />
            </SfComboBox>
            @code {
                public class Countries
                {
                    public string Name { get; set; }
                    public int Code { get; set; }
                }
                private List<Countries> CountryList = new List<Countries>
                {
                    new Countries { Code = 101, Name = "Australia" },
                    new Countries { Code = 102, Name = "Canada" }
                };
                private void CustomValue(CustomValueSpecifierEventArgs<Countries> args)
                {
                    args.Item = new Countries { Code = 103, Name = args.Text };
                }
            }

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfDropDownList`2.UpdateDisableItem(`1)
member.summary: Updates the disabled status of a given item in the list.
member.param: The item to be updated.
member.remarks: This method checks if the given item is not null and if it's not disabled. If so, it sets the disabled field of the item to true. It then updates the item in the ListData and disables the corresponding list item in the ListDataSource. If the item to be disabled is currently selected, it updates the value selection asynchronously.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.FilterType
member.summary: Determines which filter type the DropDown component uses during search operations.

remarks.para: This enumeration specifies how the search term is matched with the item values during search actions in filtering-enabled components such as SfDropDownList, SfComboBox and others that support filtering.

example.code: FilterType filterType = FilterType.StartsWith; // Use this filter type in the component's search settings

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.FilterType.StartsWith
member.summary: Filter items whose value begins with the given search term.
member.value: The item value must start with the search text to match.
member.remarks: Use for prefix-based search in most filtering scenarios.

example.code: FilterType type = FilterType.StartsWith;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.FilterType.EndsWith
member.summary: Filter items whose value ends with the provided search term.
member.value: The item value must end with the search text to match.
member.remarks: Useful for suffix-based searches where the search term should be at the end.

example.code: FilterType type = FilterType.EndsWith;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.FilterType.Contains
member.summary: Filter items in which the search term appears anywhere within the item value.
member.value: The item value may contain the search text at any position to match.
member.remarks: Typically used for substring searching within item values.

example.code: FilterType type = FilterType.Contains;

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.VisualMode
member.summary: Determines the visual mode behavior for the SfMultiSelect Dropdown component.

remarks.para: Controls how selected items are displayed in the MultiSelect component, allowing for delimiter, box, and checkbox visual representations.

example.code: VisualMode mode = VisualMode.Delimiter;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.VisualMode.Default
member.summary: Specifies the default visual mode where selected items are displayed as a comma-separated list.
member.value: Displays items in the MultiSelect box as delimited text (default behavior).
member.remarks: The mode is used for typical list controls.

example.code: VisualMode mode = VisualMode.Default;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.VisualMode.Delimiter
member.summary: Displays selected items in the MultiSelect as a delimited string based on the configured delimiter.
member.value: Shows selected value as a customizable delimiter-separated string.
member.remarks: Provides better readability for multiple selected values.

example.code: VisualMode mode = VisualMode.Delimiter;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.VisualMode.Box
member.summary: Shows selected items in boxed segments inside the MultiSelect field.
member.value: Each selected item appears as a separate colored box with an option to remove.
member.remarks: Useful for tag-style or chip-style selection presentations.

example.code: VisualMode mode = VisualMode.Box;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.VisualMode.CheckBox
member.summary: Each selection is displayed with a checkbox next to items in the dropdown list.
member.value: Allows checkbox-based selection of multiple items in the dropdown list.
member.remarks: Recommended where users are familiar with checkbox multi-selection.

example.code: VisualMode mode = VisualMode.CheckBox;

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SortOrder
member.summary: Specifies the sort order used to arrange items in a data-bound list component.
member.remarks: Sort order can be configured for SfDropDownList, SfComboBox, SfAutoComplete, and other DropDown components that support sorting.

example.code: SortOrder order = SortOrder.Ascending;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SortOrder.None
member.summary: No sorting is applied to the data source; items remain in original order.
member.value: Leave the data source unsorted.
member.remarks: This is the default option if no sorting is specified.

example.code: SortOrder order = SortOrder.None;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SortOrder.Ascending
member.summary: Sort the data source in ascending (A-Z or lowest-to-highest) order.
member.value: Sorts items from lowest to highest defined by comparer.
member.remarks: Use for alphabetical or numeric order.

example.code: SortOrder order = SortOrder.Ascending;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SortOrder.Descending
member.summary: Sort the data source in descending (Z-A or highest-to-lowest) order.
member.value: Sorts items from highest to lowest defined by comparer.
member.remarks: Typically used for reverse-alphabetical or descending numeric order.

example.code: SortOrder order = SortOrder.Descending;

member.name: F:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.HightLightType.EndsWith

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SearchType
member.summary: Specifies the available search modes used while filtering.

member.summary: Allows filtering by searching only from the start of the item value (prefix match).

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1
member.summary: Represents a Syncfusion Blazor Mention component, which allows users to type a specified character (e.g., '@' or '#') to trigger a popup suggestion list for mentions/tags and select or insert one or more items into any editable target element.
member.remarks: SfMention<TItem> supports both primitive and complex data binding, templates for suggestion and selected item display, grouping, built-in keyboard and accessibility features, and integration with custom queries and data sources. Typical usage scenarios include chat apps, comment systems, tagging, and rich editors.
member.typeparam: Specifies the type of the underlying data source for mention suggestions.
member.summary: Represents a Syncfusion Blazor Mention component that allows users to input a special character (such as '@' or '#'), triggering a filtered suggestion list for mentions or tags that can be inserted into any editable target element.
member.remarks: The SfMention<TItem> component supports custom display templates, grouping, data binding with complex or primitive types, and advanced keyboard navigation. It is typically used in chat, comments, or tagging experiences where the ability to mention people, products, tags, or other entities is required.
member.summary: Contains user actions, APIs, and internal utilities for operating the Syncfusion Blazor SfMention<TItem> component—including programmatic suggestion popup control, key handling, and disabling items.
member.remarks: This partial class provides all imperative API methods, async invokables, and advanced helpers for manipulating the suggestion popup and integrating with JavaScript interop. Calling these methods lets you show or hide the popup, handle keyboard actions, or dynamically disable items from code-behind.

member.name: M:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.UpdateDisableItem(`0)
member.summary: Updates the disabled status of a given item in the list.
member.param: The item to be updated.
member.remarks: This method checks if the given item is not null and if it's not disabled. If so, it sets the disabled field of the item to true. It then updates the item in the ListData and disables the corresponding list item in the ListDataSource. If the item to be disabled is currently selected, it updates the value selection asynchronously.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.ShowMentionChar
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to show the along with with the text when displaying selected mention item in target.
member.value: true, the selected mention item displayed along with the mention character. The default value is false.
member.remarks: If ShowMentionChar is set to true, the mention component will display the mention character along with the text of the mentioned item. For example, if the mention character is @ and the user mentions the item "John Doe", the mention will be displayed as @John Doe.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.FilterType
member.summary:
Gets or sets the filter type that specifies the match criteria while searching for mentions. The possible values for the property are:
StartsWith lists the items if the start of the text in the item matches with the search term or input string.
EndsWith lists the items if the end of the text in the item matches with the search term or input string.
Contains lists the items if the item text contains the search term or input string.
member.value: One of the enumeration that specifies the match criteria while searching. The default value is .

example.code: @code{ protected List SizeData = new List() { "Small", "Medium", "Large" }; }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.AllowSpaces
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to continue search action if user enter space after mention character while searching.
member.value: true, the search action takes place even after a space, if the DataSource data's are matched. The default value is false.
member.remarks: By default, the component will only search for mentions when the mention character is immediately followed by a non-whitespace character (e.g. @john but not @ john). However, you can change this behavior and allow the SfMention component to continue searching for mentions even if the user enters a space after the mention character by setting the AllowSpaces property to true.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMention`1.RequireLeadingSpace
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether a leading space is required before the mention character to trigger the suggestion popup in the Mention component.
member.value: true if a leading space is required to trigger the suggestion popup; otherwise, false. The default value is true.
member.remarks: - When RequireLeadingSpace is set to true, the suggestion popup will appear only if the mention character is preceded by a space. For example, typing "@John" will not trigger the popup unless a space precedes the "@" character. - When RequireLeadingSpace is set to false, the suggestion popup will trigger immediately after detecting the mention character, regardless of the preceding characters. - For backward compatibility, the property defaults to true, ensuring existing applications behave as expected.

example.code:
<SfMention TValue="string" MentionChar="@" RequireLeadingSpace="false" DataSource="@UserList"> 
            </SfMention> 
            
            @code { 
                private List<string> UserList = new List<string> { "John Doe", "Jane Smith", "Alice Brown" }; 
            }

member.summary: Gets or sets the custom suffix that will be appended to the end of the mentioned item's text when it is inserted into the target editor.
member.value: Accepts as string value. The default value is String.Empty.
member.remarks: When a item is selected, the component will automatically insert the text of the mentioned item into the target editor. By default, the mention component will insert the text of the mentioned item without any additional text or characters. However, you can specify a custom suffix that will be appended to the end of the mentioned item's text when it is inserted into the target editor.

member.value: An EventCallback<ChipSelectedEventArgs<TItem>> that is called when a chip (token) is selected. The event provides ChipSelectedEventArgs<TItem> describing the selected chip data.
member.remarks: Use this event to determine which chip has been selected by the user.

example.code:
<SfMultiSelect TItem="string" TValue="string" DataSource="@MyList">
                <MultiSelectEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" ChipSelected="@OnChipSelected"/>
            </SfMultiSelect>
            @code {
                private List<string> MyList = new List<string>();
                public void OnChipSelected(ChipSelectedEventArgs<string> args) {
                    // New chip value is args.ChipData
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.MultiSelectEvents`2.OnClose
member.summary: Gets or sets an event callback that is invoked before the dropdown popup closes in the MultiSelect Dropdown component.
member.value: An EventCallback<PopupEventArgs> that is triggered before the popup is closed, receiving PopupEventArgs that allows cancellation of the popup closure.
member.remarks: Prevent the dropdown popup close action using PopupEventArgs.Cancel. If cancelled, the popup remains open.

example.code:
<SfMultiSelect TItem="string" TValue="string" DataSource="@MyList">
                <MultiSelectEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" OnClose="@OnCloseHandler"/>
            </SfMultiSelect>
            @code {
                private List<string> MyList = new List<string>();
                public void OnCloseHandler(PopupEventArgs args) {
                    args.Cancel = true;
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.MultiSelectEvents`2.CustomValueSpecifier
member.summary: Gets or sets an event callback that is invoked when custom values, not present in the data source, are selected in the MultiSelect Dropdown component.
member.value: An EventCallback<CustomValueEventArgs<TItem>> triggered when a custom value is selected. Receives CustomValueEventArgs<TItem> for custom logic.
member.remarks: Allows the component to handle values that are not in the provided data source.

example.code:
<SfMultiSelect TValue="int" TItem="Countries" DataSource="@CountryList">
                <MultiSelectEvents TValue="int" TItem="Countries" CustomValueSpecifier="@customValue"/>
                <MultiSelectFieldSettings Text="Name" Value="Code"/>
            </SfMultiSelect>
            @code {
                private List<Countries> CountryList = new List<Countries>();
                public class Countries {
                    public string Name { get; set; }
                    public int Code { get; set; }
                }
                void customValue(CustomValueEventArgs<Countries> args) {
                    args.NewData = new Countries() { Code = 103, Name = args.Text };
                }
            }

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.MultiSelectEvents`2.Filtering
member.summary: Gets or sets an event callback invoked whenever a character is typed in the MultiSelect Dropdown search box.
member.value: An EventCallback<FilteringEventArgs> fired on filter input. Provides the filtering arguments for query overrides.
member.remarks: Prevent the default filter action and enable your own query by setting the FilteringEventArgs.PreventDefaultAction property. You can then pass a modified data source and query to method for custom filtering.

example.code:
<SfMultiSelect @ref="MultiSelectObj" TItem="string" TValue="string" AllowFiltering="true" DataSource="@MyList">
                <MultiSelectEvents TValue="string" TItem="string" Filtering="@OnFilteringHandler" />
            </SfMultiSelect>
            @code {
                private SfMultiSelect<string, string> MultiSelectObj;
                private List<string> MyList = new List<string>();
                async Task OnFilteringHandler(FilteringEventArgs args) {
                    args.PreventDefaultAction = true;
                    var query = new Query().Where(new WhereFilter() { Field = "Text", Operator = "contains", value = args.Text, IgnoreCase = true });
                    await MultiSelectObj.FilterAsync(MyList, query);
                }
            }

member.summary: Syncfusion Blazor MultiSelect input component: supports selection, rendering, and input logic for one or more items from a data-bound list.
member.remarks:
TValue: Specifies the value type of the selected item(s). Can be a single primitive, array, or collection.
TItem: The type representing each data item in the dropdown list, often a class or primitive.
Implements input rendering, focus/blur, placeholder management, floating/bottom label logic, RTL, read-only state, validation, and class attr updates for the underlying MultiSelect.

example.code: <SfMultiSelect TValue="string[]" TItem="Country" DataSource="@CountryList"> <MultiSelectFieldSettings Text="Name" Value="IsoCode" /> </SfMultiSelect>

member.summary: Syncfusion Blazor MultiSelect internal: string and style constants for component rendering, accessibility, and UX logic.
member.remarks: This partial class contains only private constant fields used within the MultiSelect implementation for element classes, localization, accessibility attributes, and internal identifiers. These are not part of the public API.
member.summary: The MultiSelect component contains a list of predefined values from which a multiple value can be chosen.
Provides advanced methods for Syncfusion Blazor MultiSelect: focus management, popup show/hide, item selection, filtering, data retrieval, and runtime state actions.
member.remarks:
Type Parameters:
- TValue: Type representing the selection value, array, or collection.
- TItem: Data type of each bound item in the MultiSelect’s list. This partial class defines all public methods on the MultiSelect Blazor component for explicit programmatic control and advanced custom scenarios. All public methods are documented with parameter and return information for developer tooling and API browsing.
member.summary: The component enables users to select multiple values from a list of predefined options, supporting filtering, customization, virtualization, and templating for rich dropdown scenarios.
member.remarks: Use this component to provide modern multiple selection input, including grouped, filtered, and virtualized item lists. It supports custom templates, performance optimizations for large datasets, and full accessibility.

remarks.para: TItem: Specifies the type of SfMultiSelect.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.SfMultiSelect`2.DebounceDelay
member.summary:
Gets or sets the debounce delay in milliseconds for filtering the items in the component. The debounce delay represents the time delay between the last keystroke and the filtering operation. This delay helps reduce the frequency of data filtering while typing. The default value is 300 milliseconds.
The property only takes effect when the property is set to true.
member.value: An integer representing the debounce delay in milliseconds. The default value is 300.
member.example: The following example demonstrates how to set the property to 500 milliseconds.
member.remarks: The property helps optimize performance by delaying the filtering operation until the user has stopped typing for the specified delay duration. To work with the default filtering scenario, the user needs to set the `DebounceDelay` value to zero.

member.name: T:Syncfusion.Blazor.DropDowns.MultiSelectTemplates`1
member.summary: Provides templating support for Syncfusion Blazor MultiSelect: enables customization of list items, group headers, selected values, header, and footer content for advanced UI scenarios.
member.typeparam: The type of item represented in the list and templates; typically a DTO or primitive type bound as data.

example.code: <SfMultiSelect TValue="string" TItem="Country" DataSource="@Countries"> <MultiSelectTemplates TItem="Country"> <ValueTemplate> @context.Name (@context.Code) </ValueTemplate> </MultiSelectTemplates> </SfMultiSelect>
